visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The shot opens on a white kitchen counter populated with various spice containers and sauces, notably a large jar of garlic pepper and a bottle of soy sauce. A digital kitchen scale sits centrally; a hand enters from the left, adjusting the unit settings while wearing a multi-colored beaded bracelet. (2) A clear, large glass mixing bowl is placed firmly onto the scale's metal surface, preparing for ingredient measurement. (3) A pastel purple branded bag titled "Fun Maker" is presented to the camera, showcasing its packaging before being opened to reveal white flour inside. (4) The white pancake mix is poured steadily into the glass bowl, with the digital display of the scale rapidly increasing in numbers to measure the weight. (5) A close-up view of the back of the pancake mix packaging reveals a detailed instruction graphic with icons for eggs, milk, and timing, providing context for the recipe. (6) Two whole eggs are cracked by hand over the flour; the yolks remain intact and bright yellow against the white powder as they land in the center. (7) A white carton of "MILKLAB OAT" milk is shown, then tilted to pour a creamy, off-white liquid into the bowl, partially submerging the eggs and flour. (8) A metal wire whisk is gripped and moved in a vigorous, circular motion, gradually incorporating the dry and wet ingredients into a thick, viscous yellow batter. (9) A small, square-shaped frying pan on a black glass stovetop is sprayed with a fine mist of oil from a canister held by the person. (10) Two round dollops of the thick batter are ladled into the preheated pan, which is then covered with a clear glass lid to facilitate even cooking. (11) The lid is removed, and a wooden-handled spatula is used to flip the pancakes, which now feature a perfectly browned, patterned underside. (12) The finished pancakes are carefully transferred to a clean white plate, creating a small stack of three golden-brown circles. (13) A small yellow squeeze packet is opened, and a clear, amber-colored syrup is drizzled in a thin stream over the top of the pancake stack. (14) The final shot shows a young woman with her hair in a low ponytail, wearing a light-colored top; she takes a large bite using a fork, chews enthusiastically, and gives a confident thumbs-up to the camera with a satisfied expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a bright, upbeat jazz-swing composition dominated by a syncopated piano melody and a steady, light drum kit rhythm. The acoustic environment is clean, suggesting a high-quality studio-style edit with minimal background noise interference, though a very faint indoor hum is present. (2) A sharp, high-frequency "click" occurs as the kitchen scale button is pressed, followed immediately by a resonant, mid-frequency "clink" as the heavy glass bowl makes contact with the scale's metal plate. The music continues at a constant tempo of approximately 120 BPM. (3) A sequence of crisp, textured rustling sounds indicates the manipulation of a plastic bag, transitioning into a soft, broadband pouring noise as the dry flour hits the bottom of the glass bowl. The spectral density of the pour is centered in the mid-range frequencies. (4) Two distinct percussive "cracks" with short decay times are heard as the eggshells are broken, followed by a wet, low-frequency "thud" or "splat" sound as the eggs drop into the dry flour mixture. The piano BGM remains the primary melodic element. (5) A liquid "glugging" sound with a bubbly, mid-frequency character represents the oat milk being poured from its carton, overlapping with the persistent jazz rhythm. The sound design emphasizes the tactile nature of the ingredients being added to the bowl. (6) A continuous, rhythmic scraping sound of metal against glass is heard as the whisk energetically beats the batter. This sound is characterized by a high-frequency metallic "ching" and a lower-frequency "sloshing" of the liquid mixture, perfectly synced with the visual mixing action. (7) A sharp, pressurized "pshht" sound of an aerosol oil spray is followed by a soft, percussive "plop" as the thick batter is ladled into the pan. A very faint, high-frequency sizzling sound begins to emerge, representing the initial contact of heat with the batter. (8) A louder, broadband "sizzle" sound becomes prominent as the pancakes cook, accompanied by the muffled metallic "clink" of a spatula. The music swells slightly in volume, maintaining the energetic and cheerful mood of the cooking process. (9) A series of soft, mid-range "thuds" occur as the cooked pancakes are stacked onto the ceramic plate, followed by a delicate, high-frequency "drizzle" sound as syrup is squeezed onto the food. The BGM begins to resolve toward its final cadence. (10) The music reaches its final note, accompanied by the subtle sound of chewing and a light, high-pitched vocal hum of satisfaction from the creator. No spoken dialogue occurs throughout the entire duration of the clip.
